description: Keyword search in the myIO documentation (manual, API reference, FAQ, product data). The content is in Hungarian: Hungarian keywords match best, and matching ignores accents and Hungarian word endings. Returns section ids, URLs, version marks and a snippet; myio_read returns the full section.

query.description: Keywords, preferably in Hungarian, e.g. "redőny időzítő" (blind timer) or "MQTT Home Assistant"

name: myio_search
title: Search myIO docs
